plan: 1. Load data.csv. 2. Exclude participants with age outside [18,80]. 3. Exclude participants with missing glucose_fu. 4. Compute overall mean and SD of glucose_fu on remaining sample; remove observations >3 SD from mean (outliers). 5. Split by diet into usual/mediterranean groups. 6. Compute n, mean, sample SD (ddof=1) for each group. 7. Welch's t-test (unequal variances), two-sided, on glucose_fu between mediterranean and usual. 8. mean_diff = mean_mediterranean - mean_usual. 9. Cohen's d = mean_diff / pooled_SD where pooled SD = sqrt(((n1-1)*sd1^2+(n2-1)*sd2^2)/(n1+n2-2)). 10. Output all claims as JSON.
